coordinates.note: Campus-grade: the OpenStreetMap object for the ESS site; the ESSnuSB near-detector hall (250 m from the target station) has no published coordinate.

summary.plain: The site of the European Spallation Source on the northeastern edge of Lund, Sweden, where its proton accelerator and target station are being built and where the ESSnuSB near detector would sit 250 metres from the target.
summary.technical: ESS campus at Brunnshog, Lund; the ESSnuSB design places a 1 kt near detector underground on the ESS site 250 m from the neutrino target station. Marked with a campus-grade point.
